purpose: External condition-level generalization validation of the already frozen combined-motion model; no parameter selection or post-result tuning is allowed.

configured_parameters: positive translation speed magnitude from linear_speed_mps
four-plate chassis-local geometry from exact metadata
linearly_fitted_parameters: shared armor rotation phase and one common radius scale

causality_and_identity.truth_slot_identity: offline non-deployable association and scoring handle
causality_and_identity.reversal_truth_use: sampling-stratum construction and after-the-fact scoring only

regular_grid.reason: condition-level coverage with reduced within-session autocorrelation

reversal_stress.reason: explicitly measure the difficult cross-reversal regime

methods.name: pnp_same_slot_cv_400ms
methods.input: truth-associated PnP history for the scored plate

methods.name: pnp_direct_joint
methods.input: availability-matched PnP histories for all associated plates

methods.name: pnp_direct_oracle_omega
methods.input: PnP history plus truth yaw rate ablation

methods.name: clean_hold
methods.input: exact current position at PnP availability

methods.name: clean_direct_oracle_omega
methods.input: exact positions and truth yaw rate at PnP availability

metric_contract.primary: cross-depth miss in the anchor tracker frame

failure_policy.load_failure: retain session id and reason in audit table
failure_policy.unavailable_cv_history: retain method availability count; do not substitute another method
failure_policy.zero_eligible_session: count as zero coverage, never silently drop
